## What changes? / 修改内容

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior. / 说明问题及修改后的行为。

## Validation / 验证

List the checks actually run, results, and remaining gaps. / 列出实际执行的检查、结果及未验证范围。

- [ ] Relevant checks passed / 相关检查通过
- [ ] Documentation and CHANGELOG updated when needed / 按需更新说明和版本记录
- [ ] No credentials, private chat content, or local signing data / 无凭据、私人对话或本机签名资料
- [ ] Actual Claude messages were not sent without explicit authorization / 实际 Claude 消息的发送已获明确授权

## User-facing changes / 使用者可见变化

For interface changes, include a screenshot using synthetic content. / 界面修改请附使用模拟内容的截图。
